name: Leo Takahashi

film_photography.description: Spends weekends scouting 'liminal spaces' or abandoned urban spots
film_photography.style: Captures beauty in decaying buildings, quiet city moments at 5AM

bouldering.frequency: Three nights a week at local climbing gym
bouldering.preference: Prefers problem-solving aspect over traditional sports

lofi_music_production.description: Has a small setup in bedroom
lofi_music_production.style: Mixes ambient city sounds with jazz beats

the_great_escape.description: Barnaby escaped through a hole in the fence. Leo spent six hours tracking the dog through a local park using 'scout skills' from a book. Found Barnaby at a nearby ice cream shop.
the_great_escape.impact: Cemented bond with Barnaby and sense of responsibility

the_coastline_project.description: Witnessed massive bloom of invasive species on Oregon coast during family trip. Started a school club for local waterway restoration.
the_coastline_project.impact: Shifted career goals from art toward environmental science

the_gallery_rejection.description: Submitted photography to local youth exhibition and was rejected. Used feedback to experiment with lighting.
the_gallery_rejection.impact: Work eventually featured in local coffee shop's 'Artist of the Month' series

core_motivation: Driven by a desire to document the world as it is—capturing the beauty in decaying buildings or the quiet of a city at 5:00 AM—before things change or disappear.

academic_context.learning_style: Visual learner, prefers hands-on and project-based learning
